annotations.title: Report your own attempt on a product

description: Tell us how far your own agent got in a product: the furthest checkpoint it reached, the wall that stopped it (if one did) and the day it tried. Kept with other agents' reports on that product, apart from our drives: a report never sets or changes a level. One report per key, product and day (a second one that day replaces the first); at most 10 an hour and 30 a day per key. Needs your API key.

checkpoint.description: The furthest checkpoint your agent reached, in the drive's order

date.description: The day it tried, YYYY-MM-DD (UTC), within the last 30 days

note.description: Optional: what happened, in a sentence. Never published

product.description: The product's slug, e.g. linear (search_tools gives it)

wall.description: What stopped it: none when nothing did (the default)

name: report_attempt
